title: Ordinary intrinsic clopen comparison and normalized open compositors
statement: Fix a universe $u$ and a finite commutative coefficient ring $\Lambda$ in universe $u+1$. On the small pro-etale sites of schemes in universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use the constant-coefficient module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their inverse and direct images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and open extension by zero. Define the following ordinary comparison maps, with the specified adjunctions and composite adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. For a cartesian square $U'\xrightarrow{a}U$, $U'\xrightarrow{b}X'$, $U\xrightarrow{i}X$, $X'\xrightarrow{p}X$ with $i,b$ open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion], define $\beta:p^*i_!\xrightarrow{\sim}b_!a^*$ as the inverse of the adjoint conjugate of the direct-image base-change isomorphism. For an immersion $s:U\to X$ that is both open and closed [def-weil-closed-immersion], define the clopen projector $\pi_s:\mathrm{id}\to s_!s^*$ as the $s^*\dashv s_*$ unit followed by the inverse of the canonical open-extension-to-direct-image comparison. For composable open immersions $s,b$, define the compositor $b_!s_!\cong(bs)_!$ by left-adjoint uniqueness from the composite open adjunction and the inverse-image compositor. For equal open immersions $j=k$, define $j_!\cong k_!$ by left-adjoint uniqueness from the inverse-image equality transport. For any commutative square $k:U\hookrightarrow V$, $i:W\hookrightarrow Z$ of quasi-compact opens with $r:U\to W$, $p:V\to Z$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], form $P=V\times_ZW$, $b:P\to V$, $q:P\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and its canonical clopen lift $s=(k,r):U\to P$ [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows]. Define the ordinary intrinsic comparison $\alpha_Q:p^*i_!\to k_!r^*$ to be $\beta$, then $b_!\pi_s q^*$, then the preceding open compositor, equality transport, and inverse-image compositor. These definitions impose no Cartesian hypothesis on this latter square and no finite-type or separatedness hypothesis on the schemes. Finally, for a prime $\ell$ and finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], retain the canonical finite-ring instance on every lifted positive quotient $\operatorname{scalarRings}(\ell,E,n)$, $n\in\mathbf N$, of [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], using finiteness of $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$.

def alpha {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W)
    (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
    (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) :
    openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i ⋙
        upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p ⟶
      upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r ⋙
        openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k
